purpose: Reader-robustness grid, part A of the L-shaped design (reader-robustness investigator): robustness repetitions R3 and R4 at the registered reader seeds k0 and k1 (R1 and R2 are required by validate_spec and reuse the registered NRM1_MAIN cache entries). Lean bank frozen outcome-blind at about 15:56Z on 2026-10-20, before any NRM1_MAIN output was read: the FB2 task-only twin, both SEX-path strengths, both MINF-path strengths, the two target references and the lowest-recovery reference of the last grid. Randomized members read their registered instance per cell (R1 0, R2 1, R3 6, R4 7); no Monte Carlo replicate members. Robustness cells never change a decision or a ranking (RULES.md sections 5.1 and 6).
